entities.name: MurE ligase
observations: 506-aa query protein shows 67.1–69.6% identity and 94.8–98.4% alignment coverage to reviewed MurE ligases from Mycobacterium species.
Assigned enzymatic function is UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate--2,6-diaminopimelate ligase, EC 6.3.2.13.
The enzyme incorporates meso-2,6-diaminopimelate into the UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu peptidoglycan precursor.
Mg2+ is the reported cofactor; pathway is bacterial peptidoglycan/cell-wall biosynthesis.

entities.name: MurE ligation reaction
observations: Reaction corresponds to Rhea RHEA:23676 and EC 6.3.2.13.

entities.name: MurE Mg2+ dependence
observations: Reviewed homolog annotations report Mg2+ as a cofactor for the ATP-dependent ligation reaction.
